title: Puharich found dead at the bottom of the stairs

tellings.quote: he he was found at the bottom of the stairs. He fell.

plain: Andrija Puharich, a researcher of psychic phenomena said to have contracted for the CIA, was found dead at the bottom of the stairs in his house in 1995. An unnamed researcher says so on the show, without naming a source: "he was found at the bottom of the stairs. He fell." The way it is told leaves open whether the fall was only an accident.
